description: Source code for QRCodeEncoder class, which encodes data into QR codes, supporting various content types such as text, email, phone, SMS, contact, and location, and generates bitmap images of QR codes.

classes.name: QRCodeEncoder
classes.description: Class responsible for encoding various data types into QR codes and generating bitmap images.

methods.name: getContents
methods.description: Returns the encoded contents of the QR code.

methods.name: getDisplayContents
methods.description: Returns the display version of the contents.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the title associated with the QR code content.

methods.name: encodeContents
methods.description: Determines the encoding format and content based on input parameters.

methods.name: encodeQRCodeContents
methods.description: Encodes specific content types (text, email, phone, SMS, contact, location) into QR code data.

methods.name: encodeAsBitmap
methods.description: Generates a bitmap image of the QR code from the encoded data.

methods.name: guessAppropriateEncoding
methods.description: Guesses the character encoding needed for the contents.

methods.name: trim
methods.description: Trims whitespace from a string and returns null if empty.

methods.name: escapeMECARD
methods.description: Escapes special characters in MECARD format strings.
